text: Most membership money mistakes come from a handful of habits. Here they are, with what to do instead.
Remember: never refund, cancel or change a membership in the Stripe dashboard. Do it in Scout.
Enrolling at the visit puts the first month on today's invoice, and Stripe bills every month after. Read the amount to the owner before you click Enroll and add to the invoice.
Joining after the visit? Use Post-appointment sign-up within twenty-four business hours. Scout does the refund, so don't refund by hand as well.
If they already signed up online, don't enroll them again. Use Owner paid, refund visit.
When Scout asks which benefit to use, pick one. Don't close the question, and don't type a price by hand.
When benefits are paused, charge regular prices until the payment is settled.
To cancel, use Cancel on the pet's Membership section, and read the preview to the owner first.
When a pet passes, always accept the wrap-up. If you close it, the membership keeps billing.
The seventy-five dollar second-pet credit posts by itself. Don't add it by hand, or the family gets it twice.
Each of these has its own video. Remember: never refund, cancel or change a membership in the Stripe dashboard. Do it in Scout.
